753:t_115:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「The way the small ones come at me with one heart... is both endearing and pitiful.」

753:t_115:4.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「An ego that looks down on everything and makes itself the absolute...! You're no different from $$ズール$$!」

753:t_115:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Being lumped in with a being like that is unpleasant.」

753:t_115:6.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「Then I'll correct myself! Your self-righteousness is even worse than $$ズール$$'s!」

753:t_115:7.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「I won't let a guy like that do whatever he wants with the universe! I won't hand everyone's future over to someone who doesn't know the meaning of love!!」

753:t_115:8.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「$$コスモクラッシャー$$, charge! Let's do this, everyone!」

753:t_116:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$シモン$$... From now on, you will learn for the first time what a true limit is.」

753:t_116:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「Now that's something to look forward to!」

753:t_116:2.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「It's pointless, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$. Telling $$シモン$$ that only has the opposite effect.」

753:t_116:3.en:
$$シモン$$
「I've seen limits plenty of times before now! But every time, my drill broke right through them!」

753:t_116:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That's why I told you, didn't I? What I'll show you is a true limit.」

753:t_116:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「No matter how hard you struggle, no matter how much you stake your life... there is one thing you can never surpass. And that is my very existence.」

753:t_116:6.en:
$$シモン$$
「Enough of the big talk! From here on, it's a clash of pride and guts, man to man!」

753:t_116:7.en:
$$シモン$$
「Here I come, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I'll overcome the limit you talk about and keep on going!」

753:t_116:8.en:
$$シモン$$
「I'll break through heaven and dimensions alike! That's how I live... how humans live!!」

753:t_117:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Living as a teacher to children on a remote island, far removed from the glittering world...」

753:t_117:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That was the life that truly suited you, and yet here at the end of myth, you point a gun at me.」

753:t_117:2.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「That way of living is the one I'd want for myself, too.」

753:t_117:3.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「But you know what! If someone is out to snuff out those kids' futures, Miss $$ヨマコ$$ will fight that guy with everything she's got!」

753:t_117:4.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Get ready, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I'm going to beat you, save the universe, and then go back to those kids!!」

753:t_117:5.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
($$キタン$$...! Lend us your strength!)

753:t_118:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Boy. You're mistaking recklessness for courage.」

753:t_118:1.en:
$$ギミー$$
「Recklessness is a $$大グレン団$$ tradition! And so is grabbing victory on that momentum!」

753:t_118:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Tradition? Using that word in front of one who has lived for 120 million years is nothing short of laughable.」

753:t_118:3.en:
$$ギミー$$
「Shut up! We're going to get past you and build the next 120 million years starting right here!」

753:t_118:4.en:
$$ギミー$$
「To take that first step, too, there's no way I'm losing to the likes of you!!」

753:t_119:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Girl. You're fighting while trembling in fear, aren't you?」

753:t_119:1.en:
$$ダリー$$
「So what if I am!? I'm a member of $$大グレン団$$, too!」

753:t_119:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I could free you from your fear and even grant you a peaceful sleep.」

753:t_119:3.en:
$$ダリー$$
「I'll overcome the fear inside me myself! $$ギミー$$ and I have lived that way!」

753:t_119:4.en:
$$ダリー$$
「So I won't lose! I'll shake off every word you say!」

753:t_120:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$ノリコ$$, $$カズミ$$... Let me commend you for saving a certain world 12,000 years ago.」

753:t_120:1.en:
$$カズミ$$
「We don't need any of that.」

753:t_120:2.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Because we're about to save the universe from a crisis that comes once every 120 million years!」

753:t_120:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That is a fate that can no longer be stopped. You would do well to accept that fact quietly.」

753:t_120:4.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「We won't follow a fate somebody else decided!」

753:t_120:5.en:
$$カズミ$$
「The power to overcome it... that's the flame that dwells in this $$ガンバスター$$!」

753:t_120:6.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You are fools. I allowed you to die in peace, and yet you choose pain of your own accord?」

753:t_120:7.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「No matter how hard or painful it gets, we won't give up until the very last moment!」

753:t_120:8.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Not waiting for a miracle, but making one happen with our own hands...!」

753:t_120:9.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「By defeating you, the final enemy!」

753:t_120:10.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Because that's the love, effort, and guts $$コーチ$$ taught us!!」

753:t_121:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I thought you were a shady guy, but I never expected you to start calling yourself a god!」

753:t_121:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I was not born a god. I simply resolved to call myself one, with my own resolve and responsibility.」

753:t_121:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Let us rejoice together, $$ラルク$$, that we were present at the moment a god was born along with a new world.」

753:t_121:3.en:
$$ラルク$$
「No thanks! I want no part of a world built on the ruin of ours, and I want no part of a pushy god either!」

753:t_121:4.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I don't care if you're a god or a devil! But if you take what's precious to us, I'll be your opponent!」

753:t_121:5.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Even if I'm no longer $$トップレス$$, I still have fighting spirit... effort and guts! They give me the power to protect the world!!」

753:t_122:0.en:
$$チコ$$
「The god I wished to as a kid was nothing like you.」

753:t_122:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I'd rather you not confuse a product of your imagination with the real me, $$チコ$$.」

753:t_122:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「But if it's what you wish, I'll do my best to grant it.」

753:t_122:3.en:
$$チコ$$
「Then save this universe, and while you're at it, vanish all by yourself!」

753:t_122:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That I cannot do. Because my existence is the universe itself.」

753:t_122:5.en:
$$チコ$$
「Then stop acting all high and mighty calling yourself a god! I'll do it with my own power!」

753:t_122:6.en:
$$チコ$$
「I'll beat you and save this universe! I fight to grant someone's wish!!」

753:t_123:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I shall save you from your suffering, $$ニコラ$$.」

753:t_123:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You could become a $$真徒$$ of the new world. If you do, I will grant you eternity as well.」

753:t_123:3.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「An attractive offer. Then I'll take you up on those words...」

753:t_123:4.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「The me from a little while ago would have answered that way.」

753:t_123:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Will you throw away your last chance out of bravado?」

753:t_123:6.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Sorry, but I have my pride, too! I'm not so much of a kid that I'd stay in short pants forever!」

753:t_123:7.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「So that's how it is, self-proclaimed god! I'll bury you along with my boyhood!!」

753:t_124:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$葵$$, $$くらら$$, $$朔哉$$, $$ジョニー$$, $$エイーダ$$... The time has come for the beasts to go to sleep as well.」

753:t_124:1.en:
$$葵$$
「Just from absorbing the other $$御使い$$s, you've started acting like quite the big shot, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$.」

753:t_124:2.en:
$$くらら$$
「And now you're even starting in on delusions of grandeur, calling yourself a god.」

753:t_124:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「There's no need to put on a brave front. You should be able to sense my power by instinct.」

753:t_124:5.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「You think that much would make us flinch?」

753:t_124:6.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「Too bad. We've come all this way by defeating every enemy like that.」

753:t_124:7.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That was until now. I am mightier than any opponent you have ever fought.」

753:t_124:8.en:
$$葵$$
「But we'll get past that! That's how we live... the way of $$チームＤ$$!」

753:t_124:9.en:
$$葵$$
「Ready, everyone! It's the biggest, final battle. Let's burn it all out!」

753:t_124:12.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「I'm putting everything on the line, too! I'll do it!」

753:t_124:13.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「We are one! We'll do it!」

753:t_124:14.en:
$$葵$$
「We're ending this, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! This is the blood of the beast... our fighting spirit!」

753:t_125:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$赤木$$... A mere salaryman like you has fought well to come this far.」
